# Lily pad: a 14-sided disc 1.24 m across, 0.06 thick, with its notch (one rim vertex pulled to
# the middle). Origin at the water line. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pad --base-color 0.2353 0.6078 0.5294 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pad --vertices 14 --radius 0.62 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Pad
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0.6"
translate -0.52 0 0
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export pad.glb
